paragraphs.text: Pig is an obsolete and acorn creature type used for cards which depict a type of omnivorous, domesticated, even-toed, hoofed mammal.

Pig originally debuted as a creature type in Portal Three Kingdoms on Zodiac Pig . It was later given errata to be Boar during the Grand Creature Type Update and all eternal legal pigs retain that type. The type was also featured in Unhinged on the silver-bordered Atinlay Igpay though it was written as Igpay due to the card being written in Pig Latin .
